name: Ever Green Melody
source:
Do you remember the song you played for me?

It was called...

[b]Ever Green Melody[/b].

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050313074344fw_/http://harmony.whitesnow.jp/game/egm-introduce.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
你还记得为我演奏的那首曲子吗？

它叫作……

[b]Ever Green Melody[/b]。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050313074344fw_/http://harmony.whitesnow.jp/game/egm-introduce.html]官方网站[/url]]
